reviews.title: Excellent Coverage and Smooth Finish
reviews.body: Rust-Oleum Painter’s Touch 2X Ultra Cover spray paint delivers great results with minimal effort. It sprays evenly, provides excellent coverage, and dries to a smooth, professional-looking finish. The paint adheres well to a variety of surfaces and makes it easy to refresh furniture, décor, and DIY projects.The spray nozzle is comfortable to use and provides consistent coverage with good control, helping reduce drips. It also dries relatively quickly, making projects faster to complete.Overall, this is a high-quality spray paint that’s easy to use, durable, and offers excellent value. I would definitely purchase it again.

reviews.author: Johan

reviews.title: total improvement
reviews.body: my bumper and door guards on a Jeep sport were looking oxidized and even showing this green color. It is now classic status. I had tried all the bumper renew products and they just aren't doing that great anymore. YT had a video on how to spray Rustoleum on pitted rims and I did that last year as they were chrome look. Made a vast improvement. I turned once again to Rustoleum to renew my bumper. Prep was cleaning with dawn in hot water followed by rubbing alcohol. Then 3 light coats with flat black as I didn't want any shine, just not faded. I waited 20 mins between coats. It will hit 101 today so I think by evening it will cure out fine. It recommends clear coating it, will opt out of that, cuz I have knicks and other blemishes the black hides, don't want those emphasized. It went on fantastic NO runs, took out the green spots. It looks maintained now. I can't hope for factory fresh on a well used XJ. Probably will hit the luggage rack with it as well.  I did spray all the roof rail runners that were rusting out with rustoleum and they look great after a year. Great product for my uses.  3 coats on front and back bumper, 2 coats on the door guards and two coats on the luggage rack from this can.
